result:
Most of the `reply_to` support was already in the repo. I only added the missing UI pieces, and I haven't run the specs or loaded the app to check any of it.

**Already there:**
- The `reply_to` custom variable (`app/models/custom_variable.rb`).
- A seed entry for it (`db/seeds.rb`).
- The `reply_to` column on both `email_templates` and `notification_logs` (`db/schema.rb`).
- Setting the header in `lib/notifier.rb`, `EmailTemplate#update_mailer_headers` and `DeviseMailer`.

**What I added:**
- **Email templates:** `reply_to` now appears in the create and update forms in `app/controllers/email_templates_controller.rb`, so each template can set its own value.
- **Labels:** pt-BR labels for the `reply_to` field on email templates ("Template do Responder Para") and on notification logs ("Responder Para").

I didn't touch the existing tests.
